# dsh-mdl-promptboost
DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that injects a small, engineered **execution-intensity prompt** into
the system prompt. It favors verified work over thrift: run the checks, report the conclusion first,
and do not claim something was verified unless it was.
The plugin adds a configuration card to the DSH plugin manager, a runtime tool named `promptboost`,
and the `/dsh-boost` slash command.
## Features

- Injects one system-prompt section before DSH's plan policy.
- Three text sources, highest priority

ded after the selected prompt.
- Enable/disable immediately, without restarting the host.
- No files
ystem writes, network calls, subprocesses, or dynamic code loading.

## Configuration
Open the plugin manager page and select **执行强度提示**. The host-owned form writes three keys:
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. When off, nothing is injected. |
| `prompt` | `""` | Full repl

acement text. Empty means use the built-in core. |
| `extraText` | `""` | Appended after the selecte
d prompt; may be empty. |
The bundled patch sets `enabled: true` and leaves the two text fields at their defaults.

## How it works
- `lib/index.js` declares the bundle, config schema, host-side system-prompt section, tool, and comm

and.
- `lib/client.js` registers the row configuration card on the plugin manager page.
- `cordis.pa
tch.yml` inserts the `mdl-promptboost` row into the DSH composition.
The prompt is read lazily on every render, so changes from the configuration card or runtime control
s take effect in the same process.
## Compatibility

- DSH: `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`
- Node.js: `>=22.19`
- Runtime: pure JavaScript, no native build step
